Callout.Name: Overloaded Pickup
Callout.Message: Pickup carrying a dangerous load on the freeway.
Callout.Advisory: Load unsecured, driver unaware of the problem.

Script.Line: It is sitting on the bump stops and the load is not strapped.
There are sheets of steel on it and nothing holding them down.
It came past me and the whole truck was moving sideways.

Lines.Approach: Whatever is on the back of that is one pothole away from the windscreen behind it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
